settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer:
Standard UK delivery is £5 on orders up to £49.99, and free on orders of £50 or more.

Need it sooner? Next Working Day delivery is £9 on any order, placed by 1pm, to UK mainland addresses.

settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: Order by 1pm for Next Working Day delivery (£9) to UK mainland addresses. Smaller orders are sent first class with Royal Mail and larger ones by courier, both on a signed-for service.

settings.answer: Yes. For carriage outside the UK, email us at hello@themeltco.com and we will let you know the options.

settings.question: How long does each size burn for?
settings.answer: Roughly: Travel Tin 22 hours, Room Scenter 22 hours, Short & Fat 70 hours, Tall & Thin 75 hours, Luxury Glass Jar 80 hours and Tall & Fat 160 hours.

settings.question: How do I look after a candle?
settings.answer: Keep the wick trimmed to around 4mm before and during burning. If the flame is large and the candle starts to smoke, the wick has grown too long – put it out and trim it before relighting. Never leave a burning candle unattended, in a draught or near another heat source, and always burn it on a heatproof surface out of reach of children and pets.

settings.question: Are your candles vegan?
settings.answer: Yes. All our handmade candles are vegan and never tested on animals. We don’t use palm wax, and we avoid beeswax too.

settings.question: Why does the first burn matter?
settings.answer: Let the first burn go on until the melted wax reaches the edge of the candle. That sets how it burns for the rest of its life, and helps stop it tunnelling down the middle.
